newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Resources Development in S$3.7 mln deal.
newsitem.headline: Resources Development in S$3.7 mln deal.

text.p: Resources Development Corp Ltd said on Monday its subsidiary, RDC Marine Pte Ltd, has entered a S$3.7 million deal with Link Highway Shipping Pte Ltd for an equity stake in RM Shipping Pte Ltd (RMS).
The objective of RMS is to purchase, own and operate a converted bulk bitumen carrier.

The company said in a statement the investment was in line with its strategy to provide in-house support for the transportation requirements of Asphalt Distribution Co Ltd, its Vietnamnese subsidiary.
